description_en: Queries the cloud recording usage of ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication
name: DescribeLiveRtcRecordUsageData

parameters.help_en: The start time for the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time)
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for the query. The query granularity must be ≥ 5 minutes and ≤ 31 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time)
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。查询粒度≥5 分钟且≤31 天。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication application. You can view the ID in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2355593.html. Navigate to ApsaraVideo Live > Live+ > Real-time Communication > Application Management to view your application IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实时音视频应用 ID。可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2355593.html中查看。通过访问 视频直播>直播+>实时音视频>应用管理 可以查看拥有的应用 ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The recording mode. Valid values:

0: single-stream recording mode.

1: stream mixing recording mode
parameters.help_zh:
录制模式：

0：单流录制模式。

1：混流录制模式
parameters.name: record_mode

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity for the query data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

3600 (default).

86400
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度。单位：秒。取值：

3600（默认）。

86400
parameters.name: interval

AppId.description_en: The ID of the ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication application that was queried
AppId.description_zh: 需要查询的实时音视频应用ID

AudioSummaryDuration.description_en: The audio-only summary duration. Unit: seconds
AudioSummaryDuration.description_zh: 纯音频汇总时长，单位：秒

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the data point. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time)
Timestamp.description_zh: 数据统计时刻。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

V1080Duration.description_en: The duration of video above 720p. Unit: seconds

V480Duration.description_en: The duration of video at 480p or lower. Unit: seconds

V720Duration.description_en: The duration of video at 720p or lower. Unit: seconds

RecordMode.description_en:
The recording mode. Valid values:

0: single-stream recording mode.

1: stream mixing recording mode
RecordMode.description_zh:
录制模式。

0：单流录制模式。

1：混流录制模式

TotalSummaryDuration.description_en: The total summary duration. Unit: seconds

V1080SummaryDuration.description_en: The summary duration of video above 720p (including 1080p). Unit: seconds
V1080SummaryDuration.description_zh: 720P以上（含1080P）视频汇总时长，单位：秒

V480SummaryDuration.description_en: The summary duration of video at 480p or lower. Unit: seconds
V480SummaryDuration.description_zh: 480P及以下视频汇总时长，单位：秒

V720SummaryDuration.description_en: The summary duration of video at 720p or lower. Unit: seconds
V720SummaryDuration.description_zh: 720P及以下视频汇总时长，单位：秒
